title: Reachability under endpoint equality
statement: Let a deterministic register machine, oracle, input, and configuration property $G$ be fixed. If configuration $b$ is reachable from configuration $a$ by a finite run whose configurations before the endpoint satisfy $G$, then any configuration equal to $b$ is also reachable from $a$ by such a run.
hypotheses_covered: There is a finite run from $a$ to $b$
Every configuration along that run strictly before its endpoint satisfies $G$
